items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: all the separation axioms listed in the chapter's definition are stable under base change (source lines 488-492). The proof identifies the diagonal of the base changed morphism with the base change of the original diagonal along X' x_{Y'} X' -> X x_Y X, and then invokes the fact that each of the properties of the diagonal used in the definition of separation (properties of representable morphisms) is stable under base change.
